name: IM-1 Odysseus

locations.label: Near Malapert A, Lunar South Polar Region

summary: IM-1 Odysseus achieved the first American commercial soft landing on the Moon.
hook: I touched down near the lunar south pole in 2024 under NASA Commercial Lunar Payload Services.
how_it_worked: Used liquid methane and liquid oxygen propulsion along with NASA Doppler Lidar sensor guidance.
science: Demonstrated precision landing sensors and captured radio astronomy measurements in the south polar region.

facts.text: Landed at roughly 80 degrees South, the southernmost point reached by an operational lunar lander at the time.
Carried a retroreflector instrument for future precision navigation around the Moon.

image.alt: Intuitive Machines Nova-C lunar lander for the IM-1 mission
